subject: GST Demand Notice - PQR Enterprises
message: This is an urgent notice regarding GST mismatch for GSTIN 27AABCP1234F1ZD for the period April 2025 to March 2026. There is a discrepancy of Rs. 75,000 in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. Please submit reconciliation documents immediately. Last date: 10 October 2026. Non-compliance will attract penalty under Section 122 of GST Act.
